page_title: LEE 3-3 LIV | Leeds v Liverpool 06/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+10' Leeds enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
90+6' 3 - 3 Goal! Ao Tanaka (Leeds) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 3:3.
90+6' Anton Stach (Leeds) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
90+5' Anton Stach (Leeds) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
90+3' A substitution has been made. Jayden Bogle goes off and Sebastiaan Bornauw (Leeds) comes on.
90+3' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes a short corner kick.
90+1' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Anthony Taylor ignores the protests.
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Anthony Taylor shows a yellow card to Pascal Struijk (Leeds) for a tough tackle.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ethan Ampadu trots off the pitch and is replaced by Joel Piroe (Leeds).

86' Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
84' Here is a change. Hugo Ekitike is going off and Arne Slot gives the last tactical orders to Alexander Isak (Liverpool).
83' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Cody Gakpo as he is replaced by Wataru Endo (Liverpool).

82' Ao Tanaka (Leeds) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and low towards the middle of the target. It would have ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Alisson and his nice save.
80' The main referee, Anthony Taylor, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) is given a yellow card for dissent.
80' 2 - 3 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom left corner. Good team effort!
78' Lucas Perri makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the left-hand post by Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) after a cross from the side.
78' Great teamplay by Liverpool as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
75' 2 - 2 Goal! Brenden Aaronson slips a clever pass through to Anton Stach (Leeds), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the left side of the goal. 2:2.
75' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Leeds.
73' 1 - 2 Goal! Alisson gets a hand on the penalty from Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds), but can't stop it from flying inside the right post.
73' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
72' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Leeds!

71' Play continues despite the shouts by some Leeds players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Anthony Taylor interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
68' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) prepares to take a corner kick.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Florian Wirtz departs the field of play to be replaced by Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool).
68' Arne Slot has decided to make a change. Joe Gomez (Liverpool) replaces Conor Bradley.

68' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom right corner. Lucas Perri is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
65' Substitution. Ilia Gruev walks off the pitch and Ao Tanaka (Leeds) comes on as a substitute.
65' Daniel Farke decides to make a substitution. Jaka Bijol will be replaced by Brenden Aaronson (Leeds).
65' Substitution. Wilfried Gnonto (Leeds) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Noah Okafor walks off.

65' Jayden Bogle (Leeds) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. His dangerous effort is blocked by Alisson, who makes a glorious save!
63' Neat passing move from Liverpool in order to create new attacking opportunities.
60' 38:62 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
57' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Lucas Perri comes off his line to intercept.
57' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle after Noah Okafor (Leeds) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
54' The resulting corner from Anton Stach (Leeds) is cleared.
53' Referee Anthony Taylor points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) goes wild in celebration.
52' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Liverpool players aren’t happy.
50' 0 - 2 Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) hits a shot towards goal after getting on the end of a cross and the goalkeeper fails to keep it out even though the ball is not struck perfectly!
50' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lucas Perri intercepts the ball.
48' 0 - 1 Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) strikes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and it goes straight inside the left post!
47' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+3' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) sees a yellow card from Anthony Taylor after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
45+2' Anton Stach (Leeds) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Liverpool are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
41' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
40' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

40' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort. The ball is out of play. Liverpool win a corner kick.
39' Pascal Struijk (Leeds) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Liverpool.
37' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
35' Jaka Bijol (Leeds) takes the corner with a short pass.
34' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) sends a long ball in, but Lucas Perri comfortably gathers the ball.
32' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
31' Leeds seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
28' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Cody Gakpo (Liverpool).

27' Dominik Szoboszlai floats over the free kick into a crowded box. Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) does well to win the ball, but sends his header just over the bar from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leeds.
26' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Anthony Taylor didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
26' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. Liverpool have been awarded a free kick.
24' Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.

22' It looked like the long-range shot by Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) would end up in the net, but the effort went slightly over the bar. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time. The ball goes out of play and Leeds will have a goal kick.
20' Today's referee Anthony Taylor rightly decides to book Jayden Bogle (Leeds) for his harsh tackle.
20' Jayden Bogle (Leeds) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. Liverpool have a free kick.
19' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Leeds.
18' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball goes out of play and Leeds will have a goal kick.
17' The corner kick from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

17' That's unlucky! Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
16' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort smashes against the crossbar! What an opportunity!
15' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
14' The Liverpool players are exchanging some short passes.
9' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

8' Curtis Jones lays the ball off to Milos Kerkez (Liverpool), who hurriedly shoots from long range and sends the ball high over the bar into row Z. The ball goes out of play and Leeds will have a goal kick.
6' The corner is swung in but Leeds can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
5' Noah Okafor (Leeds) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him. The referee signals a corner kick to Leeds.
3' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) runs onto a rebound and unleashes a piledriver from distance that flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.

2' What an opportunity that was! The ball rebounded out to Noah Okafor (Leeds), whose shot from the edge of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
1' A raking crossfield pass from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Liverpool will kick the game off.
Anthony Taylor is the one to supervise the game today.
